extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, classifiers, and applicants seeking classification guidance for goods and apparatus
extracted.subtask_description: A scanned taxonomy/listing of patent classification headings and subcategories covering Classes 20–23 (sales & advertising equipment; games, toys, tents & sports goods; arms/pyrotechnic/hunting/fishing articles; fluid distribution, sanitary, heating, ventilation and air-conditioning equipment). The page enumerates item-level subclasses and example articles within each class.
